added_failures_note: unmeasured: the reviewed manifest names no base gate log, so the added-failure count was not taken

findings.text: blocking: DEGREE_LADDER includes 128, which equals REFERENCE_OUTER_DEGREE, so the degree-128 rung is the reference compared against itself; min_over_ladder at speed_gate.py:380 is therefore always 0.0 and the passed flag at :383 is always True, so the SystemExit(3) at :390 never fires and bar-agreement.json records passed true with RC_AGREEMENT 0 while degrees 8, 16, 32 and 64 measure 0.211, 0.048, 0.004 and 0.0066, four orders above the 1e-12 tolerance the done_when requires the runner to fail on.

blocking: the record still states the largest dense HLO constant "is one element at 282, 550 and 2,098 cells alike" and marks clause 1 achieved at :137, but the run's own receipts bar-282.json, bar-550.json and bar-2098.json report largest_constant_elements 846, 1650 and 6294 (three integer arrays of the cell count, carrier-scaled), and the node's own fragment withdraws the claim at docs/evidence/fragments/converged-forward-solve/saddle-anchored-expansion.html:131, so the primary record asserts a result its own receipts contradict.

follow-on: the done-when status row for clause 6 reports reuse as "Both imported from conic_integral.py and wrapped; the guard exits 3 on the measured disagreement", but at head expansion.py:19 imports _quadratic alone (the wrapper was deleted) and the agreement runner exits 0, so the row describes the pre-correction state rather than what landed.

justifications.evidence: bar-282.json, bar-550.json and bar-2098.json record per-state wall, fitted width, compile seconds and executable size behind slurm-bar-gate-1287882.log, but the clause-4 agreement guard at speed_gate.py:383 is vacuous and no assertion reddens on a carrier-scaled constant.
